Seat note · epic PM `session_01Y5583bs2RDd53MH6kM1ca3` (`os-steve`) · 2026-10-20T17:23Z.
Blocked-by: #24948

This PR is blocked on the maintainer decision #24948. With the tenant column NOT NULL, `POST /auth/organization/delete` returns 500, because the cascade sets `organization_id` to null on every row the organization owns. The seat holds the CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER review and the Tier H approval request until the ruling, because the chosen fix changes this diff. The seat recommends B: refuse with per-table counts while the organization still owns records. The PR stays a draft.

Seat note · epic PM `session_01Y5583bs2RDd53MH6kM1ca3` (`os-steve`) · 2026-10-21T06:37Z. The blocker in 6296904983 is resolved. #24948 is closed: its fix, #25016, merged as `688052e147` under ruling B. This PR now merges `main`, and its two organization-delete dogfood pins have to go green on the refuse-with-counts contract. Then the seat runs the CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER review and the Tier H approval request. The PR stays a draft until then.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `4f41fbf1a4c6f8818e4e9945b2772e983a28bb20`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts, packages/drivers/driver-turso/src/remote-transport.ts, packages/spec/src/data/injected-system-column-provenance.ts, .changeset/24583-tenant-column-not-null-ddl.md, 27 new testkit files (default-organization.testkit.ts in 17 packages and examples; pre-18-tenant-column.testkit.ts in driver-sql, driver-turso, runtime, service-storage, plugin-approvals, plugin-auth, plugin-security, dogfood; cli default-organization-plugin.testkit.ts and pre-18-store.testkit.ts), plus 331 test files; read to judge them: packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/schema-drift.ts, packages/drivers/driver-turso/src/turso-driver.ts, packages/objectql/src/engine.ts, packages/objectql/src/tenancy/system-write-organization.ts, packages/objectql/src/lifecycle/lifecycle-service.ts, packages/spec/src/system/migration.zod.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-api-key.object.ts, sys-session.object.ts, sys-organization.object.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/bootstrap-platform-admin.ts, auto-org-admin-grant.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/__tests__/legacy-catalog-objects.testkit.ts, packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts, packages/verify/src/read-coercion.ts, date-bucket-parity.ts, packages/qa/dogfood/test/upgrade-18x-harness.dogfood.test.ts, .github/workflows/upgrade-harness-optin.yml, .github/workflows/ci.yml, AGENTS.md (branch and origin/main), docs/adr/0131-total-organization-ownership-no-null-organization-id.md.

Read, in a detached worktree at the head and read-only: the PR's own diff against its merge-base with origin/main (f46ef4d70e; 362 files, +3259 / -75), every one of the 75 deleted lines, the two new pins, every testkit, the per-package justification beside every pre-18 relax call (asPre18TenantColumn, initObjectsPre18, relaxTenantColumns, relaxEveryTenantColumn, relaxEveryRegisteredTenantColumn, relaxTenantColumnsOnFile), and 24 changed test files across driver-sql, driver-turso, objectql, runtime, rest, cli, plugin-security, plugin-approvals, plugin-auth, plugin-audit, plugin-sharing, plugin-webhooks, service-messaging, service-storage, service-automation, service-analytics, dogfood and app-showcase (cli orphans.integration.test.ts and rest rest-stored-expression-dropped-fields.test.ts among them). Context read from the GitHub API: the PR body, issue #24583 (the 7b-0 part), execution record 6285122667, claim 6285142472, rulings 6266750393, 6267391172, 6269955919 and 6270035914 on #15194, the dev report 6311401309 and the later spec-seat note 6317289149, the seat note 6309760075, #24948 and #25016 (merged as 688052e147, on this branch), the check-runs and annotations on the head, and the Test Core (2/6) job log tail. Nothing was built, run or posted.

### ① Derived judgments

**1. Scope of NOT NULL — confined to CREATE TABLE, tenant column only. PASS.**
- driver-sql: `createColumn` takes a new fifth argument `tenantColumn: boolean = false` (sql-driver.ts:19743). Both exits add the constraint only when the declaration says so OR the argument is true: the multi-value exit at :19794 and the scalar exit at :20216. Exactly two call sites pass it: `initObjects`' create branch, `name === tenantField` (:12742), where `tenantField` is `this.tenantFieldByTable[tableName]` recorded by `computeAndRecordTenantField` (:12668); and `ensureShardTable`'s create branch, `name === baseTenantField` (:12155), asked of the base's declaration through the recording resolver (:12137) and reused by the shard's index sync (:12198). The two ADD COLUMN sites (:12164 inside the shard's `alterTable`, :12782 inside the managed table's) call `createColumn` without the argument, so an added column stays nullable. No other `createTable` site builds a managed table: :7934 is the sequences table (no tenant column) and :14725 is the SQLite rebuild, which copies each physical column's existing nullability (`c.nullable`, :14730), so a fresh table's NOT NULL survives an unrelated rebuild and an old table's nullable column is not tightened by one.
- driver-turso remote face: `buildCreateTableSQL` asks `tenantFieldResolver` once per CREATE (remote-transport.ts:2439) and passes `name === tenantField` into `columnDeclarationSQL` (:2446), whose new argument defaults to false (:2503-2506). The two ADD COLUMN emitters (:2124 in `syncSchema`, :2255 in `syncSchemasBatch`) call it with one argument. The resolver is the driver's own `computeTenantField` (turso-driver.ts:2050), the same predicate the local face uses; the local face is `SqlDriver` itself (`class TursoDriver extends SqlDriver`, turso-driver.ts:1746), so both faces answer alike, which the remote pin holds equal per door (turso-remote-tenant-column-not-null.test.ts:105-118).
- Other create paths: MySQL and PostgreSQL go through the same Knex `createColumn`; the pin runs on every provisioned dialect cell (live PostgreSQL 16; the MySQL cell is declared and not run in CI). Schema-qualified tables change nothing about the column clause. Shard rotation is covered above and pinned for a rotation without a `tenancy` block (sticky opt-out preserved by `computeAndRecordTenantField`, :12280-12292). A renamed tenant field (`tenancy.tenantField`) is what `computeTenantField` returns (:12259-12264), so only that column is constrained and a sibling `organization_id` stays nullable, matching the engine's `resolveTenantFieldName` precedence (system-write-organization.ts:199-213). An opted-out object (`tenancy.enabled: false`) returns null (:12257), so `name === null` never matches; pinned on both drivers.
- A non-tenant column cannot receive NOT NULL by mistake: the predicate is equality with the one resolved name; a multi-value tenant field would only add NOT NULL to a JSON column, harmless.

**2. 18.0.0-born and ceremonied databases — untouched. PASS.**
- No metadata change beyond the description text, no differ change: `schema-drift.ts` is not in the diff. The pre-existing `ceremonyOwnedNullability` rule (schema-drift.ts:940-965, threaded as `this.resolveTenantField(tableName)` at sql-driver.ts:13964) reads a NOT NULL tenant column under a nullable declaration as no drift, so a fresh HEAD table, a new shard and a remote table report none (pinned); an 18.0.0-born table (nullable column, nullable declaration) reports none as before, so no `relax_not_null` or `tighten_not_null` is proposed on either kind of database.
- Nothing on HEAD assumes NOT NULL at the database. The engine's organization-delete contract from #25016 refuses by rule, not by constraint: `isTenantColumnSetNull` (engine.ts:20290-20301) and `refuseOrganizationDeleteWhileOwned` (:20443) run regardless of the physical column. The D9 derivation (`resolveSystemInsertOrganization`, :7658-7710, applied to every insert at :16635) is unchanged.
- `ORGANIZATION_OWNERSHIP_SHAPE_GENERATION = 1` (migration.zod.ts:215); no file in the diff touches it.
- R2 and the fixture-18.0.0 leg on the head: the `18.x upgrade harness (opt-in)` check is green on 4f41fbf1a4; its job runs exactly `test/upgrade-18x-harness.dogfood.test.ts` (upgrade-harness-optin.yml:118-119), which holds the ceremonied-fixture R2 and R3 cases (:137-279) and the fixture-18.0.0 leg (:297-352: birth marker generation 1, "HEAD's schema plan over it holds no destructive change", boots with no refusal, every row kept).
- One residual edge, not measured here and not a defect of this PR's contract: a table HEAD creates on an unceremonied 18.0.0-born deployment (a new rotation shard, a cold table a newly configured lifecycle tier creates through `syncSchema`) is NOT NULL while its siblings are nullable, so a pre-existing NULL-organization row moved into it by the lifecycle mover (`cold.upsert`, lifecycle-service.ts:1502) would be refused. Those rows are the ceremony's (D10), which is the ADR's answer. See B4.

**3. Writers. PASS, with two declared loud paths (B2, B3).**
- Every production write reaches the driver through `ObjectQL.insert`, whose D9 step derives the organization for any write that carries none (engine.ts:16635 → :7658): already-carried on the context or every row → nothing to do; the object is federated or has no tenant field → nothing to do; else derived under `single` with the organization object registered, or refused with `SystemWriteOrganizationRequiredError`. The only arm that lets an organization-less row through is `no-organization-object` (:7703), a composition that registers no `sys_organization`.
- Production writers checked: plugin-security's grants go through `ql.insert` with the system context (`bootstrap-platform-admin.ts:374`, the grant owned by the Default Organization per D5 at :12, :465-492, :561-575; `auto-org-admin-grant.ts:235`; `invitation-placement.ts:202`; `suggested-audience-bindings.ts:807`). No production code defines or writes `sys_permission_set`: it is a retired catalog object that exists only as test scaffolding (`__tests__/legacy-catalog-objects.testkit.ts:3-13`, "No runtime code declares them any more"). The grep for direct driver-level writes outside the drivers finds only the engine's own dispatch (engine.ts:8452, :8492, :16876, :16879), the verify probes (`read-coercion.ts:74`, `date-bucket-parity.ts:191`: probe objects whose fields carry no `organization_id`, so no tenant column) and the lifecycle mover (`lifecycle-service.ts:1502`, rows copied with the organization they already carry). No production source writes `organization_id: null` (the only hits are comments and the organizations plugin's claim of orphans, `claim-orphan-org-rows.ts:94`, which reads NULL to replace it). Boot seeds, webhooks (declared webhooks read from the registry since #24681, no seeder), approvals, messaging, audit (`sys_audit_log` has `systemFields.tenant: false`), `sys_job_run`, `os db orphans --delete` (the engine's own delete) and the REST/data API all write through the engine. Pointer columns `active_organization_id` (sys-session.object.ts:227; sys-api-key.object.ts:322 with `tenancy: { enabled: false }` at :76) and `parent_organization_id` (sys-organization.object.ts:414) are ordinary declared lookups, so `createColumn` builds them nullable.
- The two compositions that can still present a NULL to a fresh table are the ones the changeset declares: a production `os serve` whose AuthPlugin did not compose (no `OS_AUTH_SECRET`), and a lean embedding (`@objectstack/objectql/core` or `createStandaloneStack` over a SQL driver with no organization object). In both the engine's `no-organization-object` arm passes the row and the database refuses it. The dev measured the first (health 200, 172 seed rows refused, 0 ERROR lines; seed rejections are counted per row, app-plugin.ts:1979, not thrown). Before this PR each landed an orphan row, which ADR-0131 D9 already names a refused write. Non-blocking: B2, B3.
- The pre-18 relax calls (the seat's addendum), every use on the branch judged by its subject:
  - driver-sql, 15 files via `asPre18TenantColumn`: the NULL-bucket unique key (`sql-driver-unique-tenancy`, `legacy-tenant-composite-null-distinct`, `8577-tenant-scoped-declared-unique`, `tenant-scoped-declared-unique`, `sys-setting-organization-unique`, `sys-position-organization-unique`, `declared-index-organization-respelling`), the driver's NULL arm and read doors (`tenant-scope`, `tenant-scope-read-doors`, `adr0120-three-posture-conformance`, `upsert-cross-organization-refusal`), the organization-less counter bucket (`organizationless-counter-refusal`, 7b-3's pin, now explicitly a pre-18 store; the cross-part note the dev raised stands), and one unstamped-row case in `21227-create-answers-stored-row` whose other cases are re-stamped with `organization_id: ORG`. Each is a deliberate model of rows only a pre-18 column can hold, the readers 7a-1/7a-2/7b-2 retire.
  - driver-turso, 4 files via `initObjectsPre18`: the remote face has no relax door, so the kit issues the transport's own pre-18 CREATE (pre-18-tenant-column.testkit.ts:52-58). `inherited-members` keeps the schema-sync-stats cases 18.x-shaped (`pre18Tenant = false`) with the assertion `{ created: 2, existing: 0 }` unchanged; `drift-detection` keeps all 8 cases (8 before, 8 after) and marks one pre-18; `migration-entries` (duplicates case) and `local-remote-tenant-scope-parity` (the chokepoint ledger's NULL arm). Deliberate.
  - runtime, 3 files: 17.x residue replayed by the seed loader (`seed-loader-null-organization-holder`), the autonumber split under a NULL bucket (`seed-tenancy-autonumber-split`), and `default-organization-statements.golden` (two uses: the CONTROL case's organization-less grant, deliberate; and the delete-and-recreate case, which relaxes every tenant table with a comment citing a cascade `set_null` the engine no longer performs since #25016; the test itself expects the 409 at :217, so the relax dodges nothing, but the comment is stale: B5).
  - service-storage, 3 files: a backfill over legacy organization-less `sys_file` rows, the TTL sweep reaching legacy `sys_upload_session` rows, the tenant-audit half repairs. Deliberate (sweeps and backfills over legacy rows are their subject).
  - plugin-sharing, 4 files with a local copy of the helper: organization-less `sys_record_share`, `sys_sharing_rule` and `sys_share_link` rows as fixtures for the stamp and reconcile pins; the production stamp itself is asserted unchanged (the headers at record-share-organization-stamp.test.ts:1-14 and share-link-organization-stamp.test.ts:1-13 say the service stamps or refuses). Deliberate.
  - plugin-security: 6 narrow uses on `sys_permission_set` (`controlled-by-parent-every-master-edit`, `-master-object-read`, `-write-shape-master-edit`, `insert-seam-judges-organization`, `readable-ids-nested-compose`, `readable-ids-delegated-compose`), each the retired legacy catalogue row a pre-18 store holds, with the rig's other driver writes re-stamped (`readable-ids-nested-compose.test.ts:246-266` adds `organization_id: ORG`); and about 30 blanket `relaxEveryRegisteredTenantColumn` / `relaxEveryTenantColumn` calls in rigs whose subject is the legacy catalogue, global sets, positions and holdings. plugin-auth (10 blanket) and plugin-approvals (2 blanket) follow the same pattern. Each is a legitimate pre-18 model; the blanket form relaxes tables with no residue too, which lowers that rig's power to catch an unstamped production write (B6, non-blocking).
  - cli, 3 files via `relaxTenantColumnsOnFile`, and dogfood, 2 files: the ceremony's input is a pre-18 store (`organization-ownership.no-organization`, `.declared-rule-mirrors`, `platform-global-column-drop`; `sharing-rule-org-less-caller`, `email-template-boot-sweep`). Deliberate.
  - No use relaxes a column to let the code under test land a NULL that production would land; where the write was incidental the fixture names its organization or installs the Default Organization instead.
- Fixture changes: all 75 deleted lines read. They are re-stamped raw writes, `SYSTEM` constants replaced by organization-carrying contexts, two helper signatures widened (`seeded(face, file, pre18Tenant)`, the 4-tuple `CASES`), the old description string in one pin, the two spec lines and the five driver lines. No `.skip`, `.only`, `.todo`, `xit` or `xdescribe` was added; no assertion was removed or loosened in any of the 24 files read. cli `orphans.integration.test.ts:355-359`: the raw `od_hold` row gains `...ORG`, the restrict assertion unchanged. rest `rest-stored-expression-dropped-fields.test.ts:70-72`: `installDefaultOrganization(engine)` before the inserts, assertions unchanged.

**4. Organization delete under NOT NULL. PASS.** With #25016 on the branch: a `set_null` lookup that is the child's tenant column into `sys_organization` is never cleared; it is counted and the delete refused with 409 `DELETE_RESTRICTED` before any write (engine.ts:19907, :19919, :20290-20301, :20443-20459). A predicate delete of `sys_organization` is refused before any hook (:20792, `organizationPredicateDeleteRefusal` :754). A user delete and a team delete clear lookups into `sys_user` and `sys_team`, never a tenant column (`isTenantColumnSetNull` requires the deleted object to be `sys_organization` and the field to be the child's resolved tenant field). Pointer columns keep `set_null` (`keepsOrganizationReference`, :20348-20351) and are nullable by construction (item 3). Rows that outlive the organization (`append-only`, `engine-owned`) keep their reference, never NULL (:20325-20328).

**5. Walled postures (R4) and `single` (R1).** CI runs no dogfood shard on a pull request (ci.yml:2037, `github.event_name != 'pull_request'`), so the `Dogfood Regression Gate` success on the head is the aggregator's vacuous answer. The evidence on the head is the dev's measurement in the PR body: R1 as fresh `pnpm dev -- --fresh` boots of showcase, crm and todo (health 200, seeded-admin sign-in 200, 0 ERROR lines, 0 NOT NULL refusals, every tenant column NOT NULL); R4 as a production `os serve` under `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=isolated` with `@objectstack/organizations` linked (health 200, owner sign-up and sign-in 200) and step 4's seven walled e2e cases 7/7 under `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly`. The cli suite, which serves artifacts through `createStandaloneStack` with the Default Organization spliced ahead of the app seed, is green in the shard (162 files, 2180 tests). R2 and R3 are CI-verified on the head (item 2). B7 asks the seat's delta check to re-ask R1 and R4 at the final head.

**6. Spec text.** The only spec change is `injected-system-column-provenance.ts`: the description `Tenant scope (stamped on insert by org-scoping; never NULL — a write that names no organization is refused).` (:120-121) and a docblock (:105-110) saying why the shape keeps `required: false` and no `storage`.
